lines.text: Jesus drove out the buyers and sellers in the temple courts and overturned the tables of the money changers.
The blind and the lame came to Jesus at the temple, and He healed them, but the chief priests and scribes were indignant.
Jesus quoted a verse about praise from children and infants, then left the city and spent the night in Jericho.
Hungry on the road, Jesus found only leaves on a fig tree, and it withered at once, so the disciples marveled.
Jesus told His disciples that with faith they could tell the temple to be thrown into the sea.
